app.name: JabeX
app.privacyNote: All data stays on your device.

common.holdToDeleteHint: Press and hold Delete to confirm. Release to cancel.

search.title: Search
search.recentEmpty: Type to search cards, decks, tags, and commands.
search.desktopOnly: Global search runs in the desktop app.

home.description: Study with a private Leitner box. Switch local profiles on this device, and back up with a portable .jbx file — no account required.
home.ctaHint: Aim for under 30 seconds — name it and start adding cards next.
home.ctaNewHint: Open decks to add another, organize cards, or start a review.
home.tourHint: A short walkthrough: create a deck, add cards, review, and open settings.

tour.welcomeBody: Your Leitner box stays on this device — no account, no cloud. We’ll show the clicks to create your first deck and card.
tour.decksBody: Open Decks from the sidebar. Each deck is a set of flashcards you review with spaced repetition.
tour.createDeckBody: Click New deck, give it a short name, then save. Aim for under 30 seconds for your first deck.
tour.createCardBody: After you open a deck, use New card to add a front and back. TipTap supports rich text — keep the first cards simple.
tour.reviewBody: When cards are due, start a review here. Grade each recall (Again / Hard / Good / Easy) to move boxes.
tour.settingsBody: Tray, shortcuts, language assist, and Leitner intervals live under Settings.
tour.appSettingsBody: Optional tray and startup toggles. Study data still stays in your local profile.
tour.appearanceBody: Switch Persian/English and light/dark anytime from the header — nothing leaves the device.
tour.doneBody: Create your first deck when you’re ready. Your library starts empty on purpose — mock data is only for developers (pnpm db:seed).

devSample.hint: Development only — inserts three practice cards into this profile. Never shown in release builds.
devSample.created: Sample deck ready — open Review when you want to study.
devSample.deckDescription: A few practice cards so you can try a review right away. Safe to delete.

cards.back: A greeting — say this when you meet someone.
A spaced-repetition system that moves cards up or down by how well you recall them.
JabeX keeps decks and progress on this device — no account required.

stats.title: Study progress
stats.description: Local counts for this profile — nothing is sent anywhere.
stats.desktopOnly: Stats are available in the desktop app.

studyProgress.title: Learning consistency
studyProgress.description: How steadily you review flashcards on this device — not a habit tracker.
studyProgress.streakHint: You reviewed cards for {count} consecutive days.
studyProgress.streakEmpty: Review due cards today to start a streak.
studyProgress.heatmapAria: Calendar of daily flashcard review activity
studyProgress.desktopOnly: Learning consistency is available in the desktop app.

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Organize flashcards into decks for focused study.
decks.createHint: Give the deck a short name. You can add cards right after.
decks.renameHint: Update the deck name and description. Cards stay in place.
decks.deleteHint: “{name}” and its cards will be removed from this profile.
decks.name: Name
decks.emptyHint: Create a deck to start. Usually less than 30 seconds.
decks.desktopOnly: Decks are available in the desktop app.

review.title: Review
review.description: Study due cards. Correct answers move up a Leitner box; misses return to box 1.
review.emptyHint: Add cards in a deck, or come back when reviews are due.
review.emptyHintDeck: This deck has nothing due. Add cards, then come back to review.
review.sessionDoneHint: You reviewed {count} cards. Great work — data stayed on this device.
review.revealHint: Space or Enter to show the answer

shortcuts.hint: Keys 1–4 grade the card. Space or Enter grades Good.

review.desktopOnly: Review is available in the desktop app.

editor.jsonPasteDescription: This clipboard content looks like JSON. Paste it as a rich document or as a formatted code block.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.hint: Images, audio, video, or PDF — stored only on this device.
attachments.pasteHint: You can also paste an image from the clipboard.
attachments.emptyHint: Add media to support this card. Nothing leaves your device.
attachments.unsupportedType: That file type is not supported.
attachments.previewUnavailable: Preview is not available for this file.

voice.title: Voice note
voice.unsupported: Voice recording is not available on this device.

ink.title: Ink layer
ink.hint: Handwriting stays as vector strokes in a local ink file.
ink.panHint: Hold Alt and drag to pan. Stylus pressure is used when available.

cards.description: Add front/back flashcards to this deck.
cards.createHint: Write a prompt on the front and the answer on the back. Formatting is optional.
cards.editHint: Update the front and back. Review progress stays the same.
cards.deleteHint: “{front}” will be removed from this deck.
cards.emptyHint: Add a few cards, then start a review — aim for under 2 minutes to first session.
cards.desktopOnly: Cards are available in the desktop app.
cards.notFound: This deck could not be found.

languageAssist.title: Language assist
languageAssist.settingsDescription: Offline language detection, translation packs, and local TTS. After enabling here, each deck and card can turn features on or off.
languageAssist.providerHint: Offline by default. Optional legacy Google remains available only if previously stored.
languageAssist.autoTranslationHint: Master switch for this profile. Decks and cards can still disable or inherit.
languageAssist.pronunciationHint: Master switch for TTS audio. Example: enable for a deck, then disable on most cards and leave only a few with voice.
languageAssist.offlineNote: Language detection, dictionary translation, and TTS stay on your device. No API keys.
languageAssist.deckHint: Override profile defaults for cards in this deck. Individual cards can still differ.
languageAssist.deckTranslationHint: Text translation for cards that inherit from the deck.
languageAssist.deckPronunciationHint: Spoken pronunciation for cards that inherit from the deck.
languageAssist.deckSaveError: Could not update deck language assist
languageAssist.cardHint: Per-card overrides. Disable spoken pronunciation on cards that should stay silent.
languageAssist.cardSaveError: Could not update card language assist
languageAssist.emptyHint: No language metadata yet. Detection runs after save; regenerate anytime.
languageAssist.failedHint: Language assist failed. Your card is saved; try regenerate.

speech.settingsDescription: Offline pronunciation for flashcards. Piper (optional models), Windows SAPI, or browser speech — never a paid API.
speech.providerHint: Auto tries Piper, then Windows SAPI, then browser speech.
speech.voiceHint: Installed SAPI / Piper voices for the selected provider.
speech.autoGenerateAudioHint: Create and cache WAV pronunciation when cards are saved.
speech.autoTranslateHint: Translate using the offline dictionary cache (and Argos CLI if installed).
speech.offlineNote: No telemetry. Audio and translations never leave this device.
speech.shadowingHint: Hear the audio, pause, then repeat aloud.
speech.failedHint: Could not generate speech. Check Windows voices or Piper models under data/voices.

profiles.label: Profile
profiles.createHint: Each profile keeps its own decks and progress on this device.
profiles.setupHint: Choose a local display name for this device. You can add more profiles later.
profiles.deleteHint: “{name}” and all of its decks, cards, and progress will be removed from this device.

algorithm.profileDescription: Default box intervals for this profile. Decks can inherit these or use their own package.
algorithm.deckDescription: Choose the Leitner interval package for this deck, or keep the profile default.
algorithm.customHint: Enter the number of days a card waits in each box before it is due again.
algorithm.inheritHintFallback: Uses the algorithm saved in Settings for this profile.
algorithm.applyAllHint: Inherit keeps a single profile default. Copy writes the current settings onto each deck as an override.
algorithm.appliedInherit: Updated {count} decks to inherit the profile default
algorithm.desktopOnly: Algorithm settings are available in the desktop app.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.hint: Classic Leitner spacing for everyday study.

intensive.name: Intensive
intensive.hint: Shorter gaps when you want more frequent practice.

relaxed.name: Relaxed
relaxed.hint: Longer gaps for a lighter daily load.

longTerm.name: Long-term
longTerm.hint: Wide gaps aimed at durable retention.

backup.title: Backup
backup.importHint: Choose a .jbx file. Import creates a new local profile and loads the backup into it.
backup.desktopOnly: Backup is available in the desktop app.

mediaLibrary.title: Media library
mediaLibrary.description: Browse and manage files stored with this local profile. Nothing leaves your device.
mediaLibrary.emptyHint: Add images, audio, video, or PDFs from a card. They appear here for this profile.
mediaLibrary.purgeOneHint: “{name}” will be removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
mediaLibrary.purgeAllHint: All soft-deleted media files will be removed from disk permanently.
mediaLibrary.verifyIssues: Found {count} media issue(s) — see details above
mediaLibrary.desktopOnly: Media library is available in the desktop app.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Soft-deleted decks, cards, and media stay here until you restore them or delete them forever. Nothing leaves this device.
trash.desktopOnly: Trash is available in the desktop app.
trash.emptyHint: Deleted items from this profile will appear here.
trash.confirmDescription: This permanently removes the item and its children from this profile. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Application behaviour for this device. Study data stays in your local profile.
settings.desktopOnly: Settings are available in the desktop app.
settings.restartTourHint: Walk through decks, cards, review, and settings again.

application.title: Application
application.description: System tray and startup options. These apply to the whole device, not a single profile.
application.enableTrayHint: Keep a JabeX icon near the Windows clock so the app can run in the background.
application.closeToTrayHint: The window X hides JabeX instead of quitting. Use Exit JabeX from the tray menu to quit.
application.startMinimizedHint: Launch hidden in the tray (requires tray enabled).
application.launchOnStartupHint: Start JabeX when you sign in to Windows (current user only).

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Every shortcut has a default and can be changed. These apply to the whole device.
shortcuts.pressKeys: Press the new keys… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.conflict: That shortcut is already used by “{action}”.
